### Highlights

- **Several photos at once.** Pick more than one image in the gallery and each goes out as its own message. One image still waits in the composer so you can add a caption.
- **Long-press no longer selects text.** On a phone, holding a message opens the menu. Choose Select text when you want the selection handles.
- **Reactions in message info.** Message info lists each reaction and who sent it. Tap a reaction to send the same one.
- **New-chat button.** The + button keeps its rounded corners while that screen is open.
